component.name: PineTime Emulator
component.summary: Run PineTime smartwatch firmware in an emulated watch

description.p: A full hardware emulator for the PineTime smartwatch. It emulates the Cortex-M4 CPU, the nRF52832 chip and the parts of the watch around it, so the images you would flash on a real watch run unchanged: InfiniTime, wasp-os, BattleTime, the bootloaders and Nordic's SoftDevice.
It opens on InfiniTime 1.16.1. Other firmware loads with --image, and --bluetooth puts the emulated watch on the computer's Bluetooth.
